panels.title: Now
panels.description: The subagent in work now: role, issue, return number, active time, tokens, time since its last step (the last minute with token use), last tool and target. Only the orchestrator: role "orchestrator" and its last tool. A tile "facts age" shows only when the facts are more than 2 minutes old.

targets.expr: (count by (agk_project, stage, issue, role) (count by (agk_project, stage, issue, role, launch) (last_over_time(agk:tokens:1m{agk_project="$project"}[$__range]))) - 1) * on (agk_project, stage, issue, role) agk_marker{agk_project="$project"}
sum(sum_over_time(agk:active_seconds:1m{agk_project="$project"}[$__range]) * on (agk_project, stage, issue, launch) group_left () agk_marker{agk_project="$project"})
sum(sum_over_time(agk:tokens:1m{agk_project="$project"}[$__range]) * on (agk_project, stage, issue, launch) group_left () agk_marker{agk_project="$project"})

panels.title: Tokens per issue, by role
panels.description: Tokens in millions per issue of the stage, in execution order, one segment per role. Issues not started yet are empty slots. The dashed grey line for the typical issue (median of the earlier stages of the project, needs three earlier stages) is not drawn: the built-in bar chart cannot take a threshold line from a query. The hidden query B holds the guarded median. The hover shows each segment; the built-in bar chart has no total line.

targets.expr: (sum by (issue, role) (sum_over_time(agk:tokens:1m{agk_project="$project",stage="$stage",issue!=""}[$__range])) / 1e6 * on (issue) group_left (slot) label_join(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(agk_issue_info{agk_project="$project",stage="$stage"},"ord","0$1","order","^(\\d)$"),"ord","$1","order","^(\\d\\d+)$"),"short","$1","title","^(.{0,20}).*"),"slot"," · ","ord","issue","short")) or (label_replace(label_join(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(agk_issue_info{agk_project="$project",stage="$stage"},"ord","0$1","order","^(\\d)$"),"ord","$1","order","^(\\d\\d+)$"),"short","$1","title","^(.{0,20}).*"),"slot"," · ","ord","issue","short") * 0, "role", "pending", "", "") unless on (issue) sum by (issue) (sum_over_time(agk:tokens:1m{agk_project="$project",stage="$stage",issue!=""}[$__range])))

(quantile(0.5, sum by (stage, issue) (sum_over_time(agk:tokens:1m{agk_project="$project",stage!="$stage",stage!="",issue!=""}[365d]))) and on () (count(count by (stage) (last_over_time(agk:tokens:1m{agk_project="$project",stage!="$stage",stage!=""}[365d]))) >= 3)) / 1e6

The hover shows the row and the role; issue, role, return, active time and tokens are in the row name and the table below (the built-in state timeline has no custom hover).

panels.title: Launches of this stage
panels.description: One row per launch of a subagent on an issue, newest first (the tokens of the orchestrator are in the bar charts, not here). A teal dot before the role marks a running launch. The marker columns show "▲" when the launch is above the 75th percentile of the same role in the other stages of the project (needs three earlier stages; the built-in table cannot colour a cell by a per-row threshold). Return is the attempt number minus one.

targets.expr: label_replace((label_replace(label_join(sum by (issue, role, launch) (sum_over_time(agk:tokens:1m{agk_project="$project",stage="$stage",issue!="",role!="orchestrator"}[$__range])), "key", "/", "issue", "role", "launch") and on (issue, role, launch) agk_marker{agk_project="$project",stage="$stage"}, "role", "● $1", "role", "(.*)") or (label_join(sum by (issue, role, launch) (sum_over_time(agk:tokens:1m{agk_project="$project",stage="$stage",issue!="",role!="orchestrator"}[$__range])), "key", "/", "issue", "role", "launch") unless on (issue, role, launch) agk_marker{agk_project="$project",stage="$stage"})), "attempt", "$1", "launch", ".*-(\\d+)$")

sum by (key) (label_join((((sum by (issue, role, launch) (sum_over_time(agk:tokens:1m{agk_project="$project",stage="$stage",issue!="",role!="orchestrator"}[$__range])) > on (role) group_left () quantile by (role) (0.75, sum by (stage, issue, role, launch) (sum_over_time(agk:tokens:1m{agk_project="$project",stage!="$stage",stage!="",issue!="",role!="orchestrator"}[365d]))) and on () (count(count by (stage) (last_over_time(agk:tokens:1m{agk_project="$project",stage!="$stage",stage!=""}[365d]))) >= 3)) * 0 + 1) or (sum by (issue, role, launch) (sum_over_time(agk:tokens:1m{agk_project="$project",stage="$stage",issue!="",role!="orchestrator"}[$__range])) * 0)), "key", "/", "issue", "role", "launch"))

sum by (key) (label_join((((sum by (issue, role, launch) (sum_over_time(agk:active_seconds:1m{agk_project="$project",stage="$stage",issue!="",role!="orchestrator"}[$__range])) > on (role) group_left () quantile by (role) (0.75, sum by (stage, issue, role, launch) (sum_over_time(agk:active_seconds:1m{agk_project="$project",stage!="$stage",stage!="",issue!="",role!="orchestrator"}[365d]))) and on () (count(count by (stage) (last_over_time(agk:active_seconds:1m{agk_project="$project",stage!="$stage",stage!=""}[365d]))) >= 3)) * 0 + 1) or (sum by (issue, role, launch) (sum_over_time(agk:active_seconds:1m{agk_project="$project",stage="$stage",issue!="",role!="orchestrator"}[$__range])) * 0)), "key", "/", "issue", "role", "launch"))
